thread:
ben_ae: POC kickoff with VectorBridge — they're evaluating a migration from CompetitorX's API. Key asks: API compatibility (headers/paths), prompt/response parity, pricing equivalence, and security questionnaire answers by EOW. Can we confirm which gaps are immediate blockers? cc @maya_presales @josh_se

maya_presales: I can own the POC runbook. Need a small shim or mapping layer and a list of 10 representative prompts from the customer. Also need the security Q template.

josh_se: We have a lightweight compat-proxy pattern we've used before. Quick notes: CompetitorX sends streaming chunks as `event: chunk` with `data: {token}`; Redwood streams with chunked JSON objects. Mapping is trivial but watch for finalization signals. Also header diffs: CX uses `X-CX-Model: model-name`, Redwood expects `model=model-name` in body or query. Example shim mapping (very small):
```bash
# proxy POST /v1/compat -> /v1/generate
curl -X POST https://staging.canary.redwood/compat \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model":"gpt-3-small","prompt":"${PROMPT}"}'
```
I can stand up a demo repo and a canary in staging.

ali_sec: Security flags from VectorBridge: SOC2 copy, KMS/customer-managed keys, VPC peering, legal IP/data-flow diagram. We can provide SOC2 and SOC2+PII redaction guidance. Customer-managed KMS is only supported for Private deployments (VPC/on-prem). Hosted can do envelope encryption but not CKMS. If they require CMK for hosted, that's an enterprise blocker unless they move to Private. Adding these notes to the shared security doc.

claire_pricing: For pricing, they are used to a flat per-request tier with CompetitorX. We need their 30/90/365 day request volumes and average tokens per response to model equivalency. If they'd like token-billing parity, we can offer a conversion estimate and a short-term blended rate for the POC. Maya — if you can get volumes, I'll produce a short comparison table.

eileen_csm: Suggest defining pass/fail criteria for the POC: 1) 95% parity on a 10-prompt eval set (surface-level output similar enough), 2) p50 latency <= 200ms, 3) no PII leakage on sample corpus, 4) integration docs + shim repo. I can drive the eval harness and run nightly regression tests against their sample corpus.

ben_ae: Can we get a minimal public-facing shim repo to show them during the customer call? Also need the security answers ASAP — VectorBridge legal said EOW.

josh_se: I'll fork an existing compat-shim and drop a `README.md` with mapping notes. Repo: https://git.internal/redwood/compat-shim-demo (internal). Will deploy a canary in ~2 hours.

deploy-bot: staging deployment: compat-shim-demo -> staging-7 succeeded — https://staging.canary.redwood/compat (canary URL) :rocket:

ali_sec: I uploaded preliminary security answers to the doc: https://drive.internal/redwood/vectorbridge-security-qna (internal). Summary: SOC2 attached; KMS = Private-only; VPC peering supported for Private; Hosted encryption at rest/in transit is standard. Marked CMK as blocker if they insist on hosted CMK.

maya_presales: I'll send an invite to VectorBridge infra/legal for a sync tomorrow 10:00am PST. Claire & Josh — can you join to cover pricing and the shim details? Ben — can you share the 10 core prompts and an example payload?

ben_ae: Yep — mailing list: matt@vectorbridge.com. Prompts and example payloads going out in 15m. Quick checklist for visibility: 1) shim deployed in staging, 2) security Q doc shared, 3) pricing equivalency in progress, 4) eval harness owner assigned (eileen). If VectorBridge needs CMK for hosted that's an ask we need to escalate to SOC/enterprise sales. :thumbsup:

claire_pricing: I'll prepare a short 1-slide cost parity with a blended POC rate and a 90-day projection.

josh_se: After the 10 prompts arrive I'll run the baseline diff script and post a short report with examples where responses diverge (token deltas + suggested prompt tweaks).

ben_ae: Thanks team — I'll update the customer after the 10m and confirm tomorrow's meeting.
